newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji TV weighted average price set at 615,735 yen.
newsitem.headline: Fuji TV weighted average price set at 615,735 yen.

text.p: The weighted average price of successful bids in the share auction of nationwide Japanese broadcaster Fuji Television Network Inc was 615,735 yen, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Tuesday.
The lowest accepted bid in Fuji Television's auction held on Tuesday was 588,000 yen, while the highest accepted bid was one million yen, the TSE said.
The lowest accepted price was mostly in line with market expectations ranging from around 550,000 yen to 600,000 yen.
Fuji Television said earlier this month that the minimum auction offer for its shares had been set at 450,000 yen.
Fuji Television, which is a unit of Nippon Broadcasting System Inc, will be listed on the first section of the TSE on August 8.
Nippon Broadcasting listed its shares on the TSE's second section in December 1996.
